notes:
Controls and exact printed lines:
- Arrow keys: move selection. Prints MOVE UP, MOVE DOWN, MOVE LEFT, MOVE RIGHT on effective moves (one line per move).
- SPACE: attempts to build a tower on the selected tile. On success prints BUILD and [EVENT] COINS:<n>.
- N: send next wave early. Prints NEXT WAVE and [EVENT] WAVE:<n> when a wave begins spawning.
- R: restart the game. Prints RESTART and reprints [EVENT] COINS:150, [EVENT] LIVES:10, [EVENT] WAVE:1.
- ESCAPE / window close: prints QUIT and exits.
- When a blob reaches the end prints [EVENT] LIVES:<n>. When a blob is defeated by towers prints [EVENT] COINS:<n>.
- When the game ends prints WIN or GAME OVER.

Implementation files and responsibilities:
- game/tower_tiles.py: all game logic, rendering, input handling, state, and prints listed above.
- game/__init__.py: package initializer (empty).

Limitations and notes:
- All visuals are procedurally drawn shapes; no image or sound assets used as required by Plan.
- Tower and blob tuning (speeds, wave sizes) are simple constants in the code and may be tuned for gameplay balance.
- The play manual shows representative console lines; in practice many intermediate [EVENT] and state lines appear during play as waves spawn and blobs die.
